phase: Post-hoc algorithm follow-up after observing fixed-tolerance width overhead. Frozen before this racing experiment's outcomes.
selection: Unchanged released metadata-only 42-series selection, all three released models, widths 30/100/300; 300 is a stress regime.
contract: All PR models within 1e-10 of the exact maximum; numerical bound separation/pruning uses 3e-10. Race stops at separated winner or when surviving candidates have all widths evaluated.
timing: Whole three-model task including validation, preparation, endpoint evaluation and refinements. Scores loaded before calls. Warm JIT, one thread, serial randomized method order, three repeats.
comparators: Fresh executable sparse, direct dense and nearest dense exact methods, each evaluated separately. No cross-run timing ratios.
scope: Numerical audit, not directed rounding or detector inference speed.
